text:
Maya K: Quick heads up — targeting 18:00 UTC publish window for py/ts SDKs. Plan: staggered rollout: 10% canary (canary-1) -> 50% -> GA. Need final pin strategy + deprecation blurb for legacy sync client. Lock branch and cadence: do not push new tags outside shiproom.

Alex R: ok. confirm npm + pypi flow? Are we using otp step for npm? who triggers rollforward?

Maya K: Flow: npm publish -> add dist-tag staging, then promote to canary cohorts. Yes OTP for npm. Py: upload wheels to internal index first, smoke tests, then pypi. Rollback criteria: >1% client errors from SDKs OR any regression in server-side 5xx in 30m OR checksum/matching failure in publish pipeline.

deploy-bot: [release-pipeline] started job 8923: build wheels, npm pack, run smoke tests.

Chris T: For enterprise pinning: create `v2-stable` dist-tag that maps to an immutable build; customers can pin to `@redwood/sdk@v2-stable`. We'll add a `redwood pin` helper in the installer to resolve exact build SHA.

Jess P: I'll draft deprecation blurb: 'Legacy sync client (sync_v1) deprecated — migrate to async client. Migration snippet and feature parity notes.' Also add migration CLI: `redwood migrate-sync --auto-flag`

Sam O: rollback operator notes: if triggered, run:
```
./scripts/release/revert-dist.sh --version 2.3.4
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.3.3 latest
python -m twine upload --repository-url https://upload.pypi.org/legacy --skip-existing dist/redwood_sdk-2.3.3-py3-none-any.whl
# notify customers: /remind @support 'SDK GA rolled back to 2.3.3'
```
I'll open the pager playbook if we hit canary failure.

deploy-bot: [release-pipeline] step smoke-tests passed for npm pack; wheel-sign check WARNING: checksum mismatch for wheel redwood_sdk-2.3.4-py3-none-any.whl (expected 9f2b... got 8a1c...).

Alex R: oh—checksum mismatch. HOLDGA. don't promote canary. Sounds like signer or CI cache flake.

Jess P: I'll stop the docs publish and add temporary hold note in changelog.

Maya K: OK hold all promotions. Sam run the revert/rebuild flow and retag when we have deterministic wheel. I'll update the release thread and email customers in staged cohort. tagging @eng-releases for visibility.
